<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
The plan is to create `src/pipeline.ts` exporting a `Pipeline` class with a static `run` method.

The delegation design needs a thin change: `analyzeFiles` currently lacks a registry parameter, so it must accept one to support the mocked registry in `Pipeline.run`.

The minimal-change approach is preferred. Adding an optional registry parameter to `analyzeFiles` avoids migrating the core analyze or fixer loop bodies. This keeps the stub thin and compliant with the constraint to only re-export or delegate into the pipeline.

The `run` stub will branch by mode. Fix mode delegates directly to `runPipeline`. Analyze mode still needs registry support because `analyzeFiles` currently pulls enabled rules from the default registry instead of the passed-in one.

Mocked services will verify the Resolved→Parsed→Analyzed transitions. `analyzeFiles` already resolves and parses files, so delegating to it satisfies the thin delegation requirement without migrating core loop bodies. The new module will export a `Pipeline` object to avoid clashing with the existing `runPipeline` name.

CLI runners will delegate to `Pipeline.run` rather than calling `analyzeFiles` directly. `analyzeFiles` should remain a thin facade over `Pipeline`, keeping the analyze loop body in place.

The draft defines `PipelineMode` as `"analyze" | "fix"` and `PipelineRunOptions` with `patterns`, `config`, `fileService`, an optional `registry`, `mode`, `resolvedFiles`, and `dryRun`. `Pipeline` is exported as a thin stub that delegates to the analyzer and fixer until 5x2.4.2.

A default branch throws on unknown modes. `PipelineResult` will be defined in `pipeline.ts` and re-exported from `fixer` to avoid moving it. Analyzer and fixer must not import `pipeline.ts` to prevent circular dependencies.

The test mock will implement `resolveFiles` and `parseFile` directly, recording calls to verify the Resolved→Parsed transition. The `Pipeline` stub imports `analyzer` and `fixer` freely for 5x2.4.1, since those modules will not import back from `pipeline.ts` until 5x2.4.2.
</details></think>
